description:
Enable Developer Mode in Odoo and create a new Activity Type. 

1. Activate Developer Mode (e.g., via Settings > Developer Tools or URL).
2. Navigate to Settings > Technical > Email > Activity Types.
3. Create a new Activity Type with the following details:
   - Name: 'Product Demo'
   - Default Summary: 'Scheduled product demonstration'
   - Default Note: 'Please prepare the demo environment and confirm attendee list before the session.'
   - Planned in: 3 days
   - Default Model (Constrain to Model): Select 'Lead/Opportunity' (crm.lead)

Save the new activity type once configured.
